sections.title: Replace parameterized/Identifier SQL with string-formatted SQL, introducing SQL injection
sections.rationale: All five hunks in this file drop psycopg2's parameter binding and Identifier quoting in favor of .format() string interpolation of user-controlled db_name/db_username/db_pwd, so they share one access-control concern: untrusted identifiers and passwords are now spliced directly into SQL executed against the cluster.
